ops.title: cci-fix-1 batch 2: defects 5,7-11 landed as cc-inbox #16-#21, v0.5.0
ops.body: Landed (squash): #16 grep matches whole rendered record lines, literal by default, --regex for alternation (defects 10, 7); #17 sixteen watched kinds (retro, posted, design, serving, ready, duplicate, stand-down, not-ours, stopped, refuse, fail, recovered, delete-list, skew, not-live, urgent) (defect 8); #18 import stack:/target: refs, imported holds/defects/blockers with stack or target refs tracked as open, closed by a later-in-time fix-live/lift/done sharing a stack (or target when either has no stack) (defect 11); #19 cci state folds state records and prints an empty-drive line (defect 9); #21 import dating never places a stamp more than 5 min after the file mtime (fixes a v0.4.0 regression that made #18's test fail by time of day); #20 drive use starts the session cursor at the drive head (defect 5; subagents share CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, so the root inherited an earlier lane's cursor 3904). Defect 7 freshness: daemon refresh (#11) makes an appended line grep-visible in 0.9 s, no change. Defect 6: the } records are complete Oct 2-3 desk-runner lines; current desk-runner settle_launch records the whole output, no cci change. Writers of HOLD lines must name stacks as <project>/<env> (tunnel/T or box names cannot match). Pre-existing: TestCompact fails under TZ=Asia/Tokyo.
